inputs.population: hold_decisions WHERE raw_final IS NOT NULL (<=> decided_at >= 1788172475)

identity_rule: Two stored listings are ONE dependence unit iff (a) they reference the same underlying asset - established by an identical stored name, a source rule (R1-R3, R7) or a documented venue-naming identity (R4-R6) - AND (b) their decision-price paths agree up to a constant scale. Price is used only to VERIFY or REFUTE an identity that (a) proposes, never to invent one. Stored coin is input.coin.toUpperCase() (src/tools/get-trade-call.ts:860), so the raw ticker is NOT canonical across venues: 10 stored coins name two or more different instruments on different venues (stored_coin_collisions), and 27 candidate groups were split on price evidence (splits).

a candidate group whose members disagree on price level beyond noise with a non-constant ratio (DISTINCT) is split; the equity side of a crypto/equity ticker collision is labelled <KEY>@EQ; a rule-derived member refuted by price reverts to its stored name; any other split side is labelled <KEY>@<VENUES>
